verses.text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.textZh: （可拉後裔的詩歌。）耶和華所立的根基在聖山上。

verses.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion More than all the [other] dwelling places of Jacob.
verses.textZh: 他愛錫安的門，勝於愛雅各一切的住處。

verses.text: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God. Selah.
verses.textZh: 神的城啊，有榮耀的事乃指著你說的。（細拉）

verses.text: 'I shall mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me; Behold, Philistia and Tyre with Ethiopia: 'This one was born there.''
verses.textZh: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比倫人，是在認識我之中的；看哪，非利士和推羅並古實人，個個生在那裡。

verses.text: But of Zion it shall be said, 'This one and that one were born in her'; And the Most High Himself will establish her.
verses.textZh: 論到錫安，必說：這一個、那一個都生在其中，而且至高者必親自堅立這城。

verses.text: The LORD will count when He registers the peoples, 'This one was born there.' Selah.
verses.textZh: 當耶和華記錄萬民的時候，他要點出這一個生在那裡。（細拉）

verses.text: Then those who sing as well as those who play the flutes [shall say], 'All my springs [of joy] are in you.'
verses.textZh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都要說：我的泉源都在你裡面。
